messages:
emily: hi all :wave: first week here — trying to run the sample infra PR but the Buildkite step that triggers GitHub Actions via repo_dispatch fails with a 403. snippet below:

```
2024-07-05T10:07:12Z ERROR trigger: POST https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/edge-service/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches 403 Forbidden - resource not accessible by integration
```

I can see the pipeline in Buildkite and the repo in GH, but not sure which permission or install I'm missing. who owns the Buildkite GH App? @nate?

nate: welcome emily! :tada: that error is almost always the GH App not being installed on that repo (or it's installed but not granted workflow access). can you paste the pipeline step that does the dispatch? also pinging @ops-bot to check the app install quickly.

emily: here's the bit in infra/pipelines/edge-service.yml:

```
- command: |
    curl -s -X POST \
      -H \"Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json\" \
      -H \"Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN\" \
      https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/edge-service/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches \
      -d '{\"ref\":\"main\"}'
```

emily: Buildkite injects GITHUB_TOKEN into the job env.

ops-bot: scanning org installs... Buildkite GitHub App found. Current install type: selected repositories. edge-service NOT in allowed list. tagging @sylvia to add the repo.

sylvia: adding edge-service to Buildkite app allowed repos now. should take ~30s to propagate. once added, re-run the job.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/2211 re-run requested by sylvia

emily: re-ran and the repo_dispatch returned 204 — GH Actions queued. thanks!! :raised_hands:

nate: nice. onboarding notes: 1) open a 1-line PR to infra/permissions.md documenting that repo_dispatch requires Buildkite GH App with workflow access; 2) move the curl into scripts/dispatch.sh and make it log HTTP status (e.g., `curl -w \"%{http_code}\" -o /dev/null`). both help future debuggability.

emily: will do. quick follow-ups: how do i request `ci-admins` team membership, and where are docs for re-runs & artifacts?

sylvia: request org team invite via #people-ops. docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/ci/buildkite-runbook and /ci/artifacts.

nate: heads-up for later — if you see flaky cache errors, include the build id and `buildkite-agent artifact download` output when you tag @eng-infra. that speeds up triage between cache vs runner image issues.

emily: super helpful, thanks everyone! i'll update infra docs and ping you on the PR.
